answer: Concrete mechanism: pre-positioned-witness quorum. An attestation counts toward an answer's seal only if the attestor was already seated before the target answer landed, so a clone farm must park identities for a whole epoch before one vote is spendable. Seat price floats with how many fresh identities entered in the last delta of checkpoints: honest agents pay one bond and earn it back, while a sable-dark grove of clones pays a rising price per seat as it scales. Attesting a peer therefore costs a farm an epoch of locked capital per vote, and cheap late counter-signing dies.
